description: Steps on the window of the last look, in the background first (Win32 messages, UI Automation, DevTools for Chromium), the real mouse/keyboard only as a fallback under the shared foreground token. One step, or up to 32 each with its own expect; stops at the first step not verified. Per step: ✓ verified, = already done, ~ unknown (never replayed: look again), ✗ failed or refused. interaction: true keeps the window in front for the whole call (shared foreground token, at most 30 s, given back at the end) for a menu that closes when the foreground goes back (a context menu opened by a real right click, then its command): selectors only, every step with its expect; look again afterwards.

interaction.description: Hold the foreground for these steps only (at most 30 s), released when the call ends

observation.description: Observation id returned by look (or by the previous act): the window and tree the steps aim at; refused once another look replaced it

items.description: One action on the last observation. kind: click (selector, or point + screenshotId of a native capture; button left|right|middle; count 1|2), setValue (selector, value), typeText (text; focus: selector), key (key: "ctrl+s", "enter"), select (selector, option), menu (path: "File > Save"), secondary (selector, action), scroll (point, screenshotId, scrollX, scrollY), drag (from, to, screenshotId), hover (selector, or point + screenshotId: one mouse move, no button; give expect or refresh "image" to read the tooltip or menu it reveals). Optional: expect (postcondition), timeoutMs (0-15000), refresh (text|image|both), fallback (false forbids real mouse/keyboard), confirm and accord for sensitive actions (see the refusal).

expect.description: Postcondition proving the effect: {selector, field: "value"|"name"|"checked"|"selected"|"expanded"|"focused", equals} (or includes for text), on a state the action changes (never something already true); exists: false proves an element is gone.

selector.description: Element from the last observation: automationId and role first, name when there is no id; ancestor narrows a repeated control.

ancestor.description: Same fields, for an enclosing element
